ministry: Ministry of Women and Child Development
title: Last Date for Submission of nominations for Pradhan Mantri Rashtriya Bal Puraskar 2026 is 31st July
text:
Press Release Page | Press Information Bureau

Ministry of Women and Child Development

Last Date for Submission of nominations for Pradhan Mantri Rashtriya Bal Puraskar 2026 is 31st July

Children aged 5 to 18 years eligible
Both self-nominations and third-party recommendations  accepted

प्रविष्टि तिथि:
09 JUN 2026 3:48PM by PIB Delhi

The Ministry of Women and Child Development is calling for online applications for the Pradhan Mantri Rashtriya Bal Puraskar (PMRBP) 2026.

Applications for the award went live on 1
st
 April 2026, with the last date for applying set to 31
st
 July 2026. All entries must be submitted on
https://awards.gov.in
.

Children aged between 5 and 18 years (as on 31
st
 July 2026), who are Indian citizens currently residing in India, are eligible. Both self-nominations and third-party recommendations are accepted. Applicants will need to fill in basic personal details and category of award and then upload a recent photograph and supporting documents. They will also need to submit a write-up (up to 1000-words) about the achievement and its impact.

The PMRBP award honours children for extraordinary achievements across six fields.The Categories for nomination are as follows:

Bravery:
 Children who risked their lives to save others or showed outstanding courage

Sports:
 Children who achieved accolades at national or international level competitions

Social Service:
 Children who launched initiatives to help reform aspects of society, preserve the environment, help the underprivileged, and stood for national causes

Science & Technology:
 Innovations, research, or prototypes built by children

Environment:
 Sustainable practices, awareness campaigns, or eco-innovations

Art & Culture:
 Children who exhibited extraordinary talent and excelled in music, dance, writing, painting, performance, or other arts.

The Ministry of Women and Child Development hereby invites schools, institutions, parents, mentors, and the public to actively seek out such talent and nominate them. Let us ensure that every deserving child gets a national platform to shine.

*****
